result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where text elements overlap each other on a restaurant card.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time ('25–35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') text elements overlap, making both illegible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the layout or flex/inline spacing of the metadata row so that the delivery time, separator, delivery fee, and cuisine type are properly spaced and do not collide.
